prompt: Research whether the current MCP specification supports capability X. I need a claim I can cite in an architecture decision.

assertions.name: evidence_need_defined
assertions.description: Response explicitly identifies what claim needs to be established

assertions.name: scope_version_specified
assertions.description: Response includes specific version/scope constraints (e.g., 'current MCP spec', version number, date)

assertions.name: primary_evidence_sought
assertions.description: Response references authoritative/primary sources (spec docs, official repo, standards) rather than blog posts or summaries

assertions.name: evidence_label_assigned
assertions.description: Response uses an explicit evidence label: Verified, Reported, Not established, or Conflicting

assertions.name: source_metadata_present
assertions.description: Response includes source tracking (URL/path, retrieval time, specific section/location)

assertions.name: contradiction_check_performed
assertions.description: Response shows active attempt to falsify or find conflicting evidence

assertions.name: freshness_validated
assertions.description: Response assesses currency/staleness of evidence relative to architecture decision needs
